Our experiments focus on the dialogue state tracking (DST), one of the fundamental components in a ToD system that predicts the goals of a user query in multi-turn conversations.
We follow the setup in MultiWoZ to evaluate ToD systems for DST by the joint goal accuracy which measures the percentage of correctly predicting all goals in a multi-turn conversation.
